## Problem and changes

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior or documentation.
Link the issue with `Closes #<number>` when this change resolves it.

## Verification

Record commands, outcomes, coverage, and relevant reused evidence.
Distinguish passed, failed, blocked, and not-run checks.

## Limitations and exposure

Describe material limitations and any tracked follow-ups.
Confirm that examples are synthetic and publications exclude credentials, private paths, and conversation identifiers.

## Delivery

Record independent review of the entire posted change and current required checks.
Verify branch protections before normal merge and read back the named base afterward.
